about.en: Berkshire Hathaway Class B bStock (BRKBB) is a tokenized share of Berkshire Hathaway Inc. Class B issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate, under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain, backed 1:1 by BRK.B shares held with a regulated custodian and convertible 1:1 into the underlying share. bStocks are admitted to trading under prospectuses approved by the ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority and are not offered in every jurisdiction.
